title: 2026北京马拉松10月18日鸣枪起跑（9月28日新闻发布会报道）
claims: The 2026 Beijing Marathon was announced for 07:30 on 18 October 2026, starting at Tiananmen Square and finishing on the Landscape Avenue in the Olympic Park central area, with a field of 32,000.
More than 265,000 runners from around the world applied for the 2026 race.
The race combined the Beijing Marathon with the National Marathon Championships.
The start uses a mixed bag-drop model with a dedicated no-bag channel; the finish baggage area was reorganised to cut queueing.
Medical provision: 26 fixed medical points, 35 ambulances, 100 AED units, 610 medical observers, a 200 square metre medical service centre at the finish, and 160 first-aid runners at 1:200.
A referee team of 433 officials covered 20 roles including check-in, start/finish, course, finish services and bag drop.
Eight refreshment stations, seven drinking/water stations and seven food supply stations were set out on the course.
Toilet places rose from 1,119 to 1,199 at the start, from 189 to 240 along the course, and from 161 to 191 at the finish.
Volunteers totalled 7,341, 441 more than the previous year.
The finish area added a second stretch and rest zone in the trees to the south of the existing area.
Runners who chose no bag drop received a Beijing metro commemorative card as a green-running incentive.
